title: Division Commanders
cross_references: transfer of control section on page 37

evidence.source_text: A division may be established in the early stages of an incident at the direction of the Incident Controller.

nodes.text: Provide operational leadership and span of control

evidence.source_text: The purpose of a division is to provide operational leadership and span of control over a functional or geographical area of an incident.

nodes.text: Manage fireground operations from a forward location

evidence.source_text: Typically a division will be established when control is transferred from the fireground to an ICC and the Division Commander will then manage fireground operations from a forward location.

nodes.text: Has control been transferred from fireground to ICC?

evidence.source_text: The process of transferring control (refer to transfer of control section on page 37) from the fireground to the ICC can, if poorly handled, cause major confusion in the critical early stages of incident response.

nodes.text: Report directly to Operations Officer or Incident Controller

evidence.source_text: The Division Commander will: report direct to the Operations Officer or alternatively the Incident Controller (if the Operations Officer role has not been activated)

nodes.text: Manage implementation of IAP/ISP for division

evidence.source_text: be accountable to manage the implementation of the IAP/ISP relating to their division, and provide input to the IAP/ISP process managed by the Incident Controller

nodes.text: Maintain information exchange with Operations Officer

evidence.source_text: maintaining ongoing exchange of information with the Operations Officer on incident situation, progress towards the achievement of incident objectives and emerging risks
reporting when: the IAP/ISP is to be modified
reporting when: the IAP/ISP is to be modified
providing briefings/debriefings to Sector Commanders within the division

nodes.text: Review, allocate, and modify specific tasks

evidence.source_text: reviewing, allocating and modifying specific tasks in relation to their division
observing safe work practices at the incident within the division
As an incident escalates the Incident Controller/Operations Officer may deploy additional staff to support the Division Commander in these functions.
